KEY PRODUCT FEATURES:
• 8 Innistrad: Midnight Hunt MTG Set Boosters
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter + card storage box
• Become what you fear in a gothic horror set overrun with werewolves, warlocks, and spooky mechanics

DESCRIPTION:
The Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Bundle contains 8 Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 traditional foil alt-art promo card, 1 oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards.

Each Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, Helper card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"), with a combination of 1–4 Rares or Mythic Rares, 2–7 Uncommons, 3–8 Commons, and 1 Land card in every pack.
